Metalline: Metalline bypasses any metal based damage reduction. (Adamantine, "Alchemical, Silver", Byeshk, Cold Iron, Mithral)
Spiked: This weapon is studded with vicious spikes, causing it to deal piercing damage in addition to its normal damage types.
Returning: This missile will return to you.
